notes: Autosaves and resource-pack reloads no longer freeze the game. Real PROF data: a pack switch caused a 78-second reload with a 6.8-second GC freeze, and autosaves stalled the server thread 1.5-3s. Now chunk writes are async on every machine (syncChunkWrites:false, never a toggle), the mod stands down during saves (SaveDetector), and during any resource/shader reload the render FPS is temporarily capped to 30 so the loading screen stops generating garbage that triggers multi-second freezes (ReloadCap). FPS Boost mod v1.0.36. Close the launcher and game fully before updating.
